slower.$description: Headroom — no semantic role aliases this step in V1.

loop.$description: One cycle of a continuous loop (spinner rotation). Not part of the transition scale.

standard.$description: Default for most state changes — eases in and out.

decelerate.$description: Starts fast, settles slow — for things entering/appearing.

accelerate.$description: Starts slow, speeds up — for things exiting/disappearing.

linear.$description: Constant speed — for continuous loops (spinner rotation), never for state changes.
